subject: COBOL-WORDS directive
notes: GR6 'A COBOL-WORDS directive does not affect any Compiler directing statements or Compiler directives' (cite.py OK §7.3.10.4 6)). Structural: the map is built from the FINAL preprocessed text (after COPY/REPLACE and directive processing) and applied only by the post-lex token rewriter and binder, so text-manipulation constructs never see it. Probed: UNDEFINE "COPY" then COPY CWBOOK still copies; SUBSTITUTE "REPLACE" BY "SWAPIT" -> REPLACE still works and REPLACE usable as data-name; EQUATE "REPLACE" WITH "SWAPIT" -> SWAPIT ==A== BY ==B== is NOT a REPLACE (rejected); SUBSTITUTE "IF" BY "WHENIF" -> >>IF/>>END-IF still work while the IF statement is WHENIF; UNDEFINE "SOURCE" -> >>SOURCE FORMAT FREE still works. No spec-derived test pins GR6: test-needed. || editions (adjudicator): 2023 only (new in COBOL-2023: Foreword list 'Additional compiler directives were added: COBOL-WORDS directive'; Annex E.3.3 item 12, cite.py OK §E.3.3 12)); below 2023 the directive word is COBOL0900
